text:
alex: quick design sync — prototype attached. thinking about anchor handles for rule cards: should drag handle snap to a grid (by priority slots) or be freeform? want minimal jank in preview sim :thinking_face:

maya: love the prototype. grid snap would make ordering predictable for keyboard users too. freeform feels fiddly when there are 12+ rules.

chen: agreed on snap. also thinking about how validation errors surface — inline under the rule vs toast at top. inline is discoverable but could push layout during reorder.

linda: +1 inline for rule-level validation. maybe a compact pill that expands on focus so it doesn't shift everything. copy suggestion: `Rule blocked: conflicting route` -> `Conflict: two rules match the same traffic` (more actionable).

alex: good call on copy. would a collapsed pill affect screen readers?

maya: we should announce via a live region when the order changes and when validation appears. example: `aria-live="polite"` text: "Rule 3 moved to priority 1". also ensure handle is >24px target and focusable.

design-lint-bot: a11y check: color contrast fail on `.rule-pill--error` (ratio 3.8:1) — recommended #B00020 on background or increase text weight.

chen: noted. also preview sim: can we toggle "simulate X% of traffic" per snapshot? Product wants cost/latency overlays in the sim so PMs can see perf impact of rule order. small mock attached: /files/sim-overlay-v3.png

alex: yes — add a tiny opt-in control in top-right of the preview: `simulate: 100% | 10% | custom` and a checkbox `show perf overlay`. keep defaults off to avoid noise.

linda: UX nit: when there's zero rules show a clear empty state CTA: `Create first rule` + short explainer: "Rules are evaluated top→bottom; lower priority runs when higher rules don't match." also include keyboard shortcut hint `press r to add`.

maya: about reordering animation — please use a subtle crossfade combined with movement, avoid layout jump. for keyboard reorder use up/down arrows and announce new position.

alex: action items: 1) implement grid snap on drag + keyboard reorder behavior, 2) compact inline validation pill with aria-live announcements, 3) update error colors to meet contrast, 4) add preview sim toggle + perf overlay, 5) empty state copy + shortcut. i'll sync with eng on feasibility and timeline.

chen: I'll do telemetry hooks for perf overlay and a small event for reorder so we can measure misorders.

maya: I'll post updated comps by EOD — will include focus states and the compact pill states.

alex: perfect. tagging @eng-frontend for visibility. thanks all :rocket:
